description: Forecast for a US place: current conditions, daily forecast with sunrise and sunset, active alerts and outlooks in one call, and hour by hour with include=hourly. Blended across NBM, HRRR, GFS, RTMA and SPC and unit-converted server-side; times are UTC ISO 8601, quote daily[].astro.local as local, and if forecast.location.timezone_resolved is false state times as UTC. For hours set `hours` (next N, default 48) or `start`+`end` for one stretch hour by hour, and check hourly_coverage (first_time, last_time, sample_interval_hours, truncated) before answering about a specific hour; past last_time say the forecast does not reach that far. Example: {"location": "Portland, OR", "include": "hourly", "hours": 24}.

days.description: Daily rows (1-14). Default 10. Does not limit hourly reach.

end.description: UTC ISO 8601 end of the stretch, exclusive; at most 168 h past the current hour.

hours.description: Hourly rows for the next N hours (1-168; default 48 when hourly is asked). Adds hourly.

include.description: Comma-separated sections: current, daily, hourly, alerts, outlooks. Default "current,daily,alerts,outlooks". hours, start or end add hourly.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Most tools also accept a `location` place-name string instead of lat/lon.

location.description: Free-text place: "City, ST" (e.g. "Portland, OR"), US ZIP, venue/address where enabled, or "lat,lon". Use this OR lat+lon, not both.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). For continental US use negative values (west of the prime meridian).

start.description: UTC ISO 8601 start of one stretch, returned hour by hour; needs end, not with hours. Adds hourly.

units.description: Units of every value in and out: imperial (default; °F, mph, in) or metric (°C, km/h, mm). si is deprecated and will be removed; use metric.

view.description: concise (default; REST's is detailed): daily has day_precip_probability / night_precip_probability (precip_probability is their max); hourly is sampled past 24h. detailed: adds CAPE, UV, full day/night periods; hourly adds ceiling, gust and thunderstorm probability, every hour for 48h.

_sources.description: Per-source provenance: what produced these values and when.

data_status.description: Present only when the platform reports degraded/outage data sources: overall state, a caveat note, and the affected sources. Absent means no advisory was available -- not a freshness guarantee. See get_status for the full document.
